description: A named daily index series (e.g. eu-vps-floor-2c4g, h100-list-median, frontier-input-floor) with its latest value, the number of constituents and the constituents themselves, so the value can be recomputed. Omit series to list all series with their latest values. series=gpu-weekly is the weekly GPU price index: per GPU model (H100, H200, A100 80GB, L40S, RTX 4090, B200) the median and lowest first-party on-demand price per GPU-hour this week, last week and four weeks ago, with provider counts and method (page /prices/indices/gpu-weekly).

days.description: Look-back window in days, 1 to 3650; capped to your history window (14 days without a key, 30 with a free key, all of it with a paid key)
days.title: Days

series.description: Series slug, or gpu-weekly for the weekly GPU price index; omit to list all series
series.title: Series
